description: Searches across all Cognigy.AI resources in the organization. Finds flows, intents, endpoints, functions, playbooks, and more by name or content. Powerful for discovering resources across projects.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100)

projectId.description: Filter results to a specific project

resourceTypes.description: Filter by resource types (defaults to all types)

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

name: search_resources
